Class ExitScreen

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<TUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.TUIScreen
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.ExitScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<TUIScreen>, InputEventVisitor
public final class ExitScreen extends TUIScreen
Terminal state of the TUI state machine. When the main loop observes that the current screen is this instance it stops the loop and shuts down.

    • isExit

      public boolean isExit()
      Description copied from class: Screen
      Sentinel flag for terminal screens. The TUI loop stops as soon as the current screen reports true; the GUI runs its shutdown sequence. Defaults to false; the ExitScreen variants override it. Lets the runtime detect the terminal state through polymorphism instead of a subtype check.
      Overrides:
      isExit in class Screen<TUIScreen>
      Returns:
      always true, signalling the TUI main loop to stop
